patch.summary:
Thesis: General-purpose vs specialist — Smartsheet documents a broader use-case set; Todoist is narrower/specialist.

Frame: General-purpose vs specialist — Smartsheet documents a broader use-case set; Todoist is narrower/specialist.. Choose Smartsheet only if your buying job matches “Spreadsheet-style work management with Gantt, portfolios and automation — Pro from $9/memb” rather than Todoist's shape. Choose Todoist only if your buying job matches “Personal and team task manager with natural-language capture — Free; Pro from ~$6.25/user/” rather than Smartsheet's shape. Workflow advantage: Smartsheet leans work-management, resource-planning; Todoist leans shared coverage. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: General-purpose vs specialist — Smartsheet documents a broader use-case set; Todoist is narrower/specialist.
- Positioning: Smartsheet is Spreadsheet-style work management with Gantt, portfolios and automation — Pro from $9/member/mo annual.; Todoist is Personal and team task manager with natural-language capture — Free; Pro from ~$6.25/user/mo annual; Business ~$10..
- Company-size focus: Smartsheet (small-business, mid-market, enterprise) vs Todoist (micro, small-business, mid-market).
- Workflow coverage skew: Smartsheet-leaning work-management, resource-planning, timeline-reporting vs Todoist-leaning —.
- Researched limits: Smartsheet — No free plan; Todoist — Not a Work OS or portfolio tool.

Limitations — Smartsheet: No free plan; Business tier pricing jump; Todoist: Not a Work OS or portfolio tool; Team features mainly on Business.

Poor-fit cases: Smartsheet is a poor fit when that limitation bites: No free plan · Todoist is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Not a Work OS or portfolio tool · Avoid Smartsheet if you actually need Todoist's motion (Personal and team task manager with natural-language capture — Free; Pro from ~$)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
